paras: Jia has an [[idea|idea]] for a short science [[video|video]]. She wants to show how a paper bridge can hold a cup.
I use my [[phone|phone]] to record while Jia works at the [[computer|computer]]. She adds titles by [[typing|typing]] each step clearly.
When the sound is too quiet, our teacher offers to [[help|help]]. We record one sentence again, and the final video is easy to understand.
zh: 佳佳想出了一个科学短视频的点子。她想展示一座纸桥怎样托住一个杯子。
我用手机拍摄，佳佳则在电脑前工作。她通过打字清楚地为每一步加上标题。
声音太小时，老师主动帮忙。我们重新录了一句话，最终的视频很容易理解。

q.s: The video is about a paper bridge.
They use a professional film camera.
q.why: The recording is made with a phone.

q.s: The class watches the final video on Friday.
